rationale: A46 requires an operational checkpoint/effect/restore proof; deterministic recovery fixtures and a simple restart do not satisfy it.
assertions: On a disposable admitted Linux/Azure installation using the candidate SF prod archive: capture a real checkpoint and backup key; cut over to Team profiles; commit an actual controlled external effect and authoritative receipt after checkpoint; restore the old checkpoint through the admitted production recovery surface; restart and retry the original operation.
Assert same receipt/digest, exactly one effect, monotonic consumed slots/dedup/cancellations/tombstones/issued IDs across every participating store; no secret or authority restoration.
Lose the post-checkpoint receipt or external reply: suspension/receipt-required, zero automatic re-execution; reconcile only with original authoritative proof.
Revoke before restore or during final await: deny; separately allow the admitted corporate recovery administrator without an eligible Team, without granting business/private-data access.
Repeat restore/restart/retry twice; isolated incomplete/corrupt backup or ambiguous ownership cannot replace live/auth stores.
Observe exact source C/tree/prod inner tar/installed closure and real admitted corporate actors on a disposable Linux/Azure installation; never promote fixture or synthetic manifest to LIVE.

Create/read legacy state through an admitted real producer or reviewed supported prior-release migration setup; record original IDs/provenance before checkpoint. No direct SQL seeding or manufactured auth.
Observe quiescence/drain→checkpoint→migration with explicit mapping and preserved IDs→business effect and external durable receipt→restore checkpoint→restart actual service→retry same operation.
With receipt retained outside restored snapshot, retry observes original receipt/result and effect counter/source observation proves exactly one external effect.
With receipt missing or unavailable through an admitted controlled failure mechanism, retry suspends and produces zero new external effect. No manual rawSQL/receipt forgery.
Revoke Team membership/authorization before restore/retry; restored caches/session/job cannot revive access; deny before business/effect.
Admitted admin without Team can perform the recovery action through its real administrative authorization boundary; subsequent business operation remains denied, no project/Team invented.
Fresh authorized corporate actor can reopen preserved IDs after recovery and new scope admission; cross-Team/tenant actor cannot.
Persist sanitized case/operation receipt hashes, phase identities, before/after version/stamps, resource-role IDs/hashes and actual effect outcome; no raw cookies/secrets/DB in CI artifact.
Every scenario mandatory, zero skips/retries/fixture fallbacks; missing environment or an unimplemented fault/recovery surface reports BLOCKED, not PASS.
